title: Pairwise Ranker II: Training
hints: The procedure is fully specified, so the real work is getting the gradient right at every step. Everything else is bookkeeping.
This is full-batch gradient descent: each step uses all N pairs at once. Compute whatever does not depend on w once, before the loop.
The difference vectors never change during training; only w does. Each step needs just the margins at the current w. Step against the gradient, not along it.
